vars.label: Buildings (Overture footprints)
vars.ref: Overture Maps Foundation, buildings theme, release 2026-10-21.0 (OpenStreetMap, Google Open Buildings and Microsoft ML Buildings footprints, joined by Overture), read for a box around Puerto Rico; one point inside each outline and its footprint area on an equal-area plane. © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL 1.0)
vars.definition: The number of buildings in the area. A building is one footprint in Overture's buildings theme (release 2026-10-21.0): the outline of a roofed structure as traced from above, by OpenStreetMap volunteers or, where they have not mapped, by Google's or Microsoft's machine learning. A building belongs to the barrio that holds a point inside its outline; a municipio's and Puerto Rico's figures pool their barrios. Sheds, carports and ruins can be counted, and buildings hidden by trees can be missed, more often where machine learning traced them.
